proving.note: the BL-079 PAHT coupons (USD 59.01) are already booked and qualify the printed parts' Z basis

coupons.what: clamp slip: 6061 half-shells + 1 x 1/4 backers + 2 x M5 A2 on a 120 mm offcut of 1 x .065, bare tube; dry / wet / wet after 24 h at 40 C under preload / -15 C, n 5 each (BL-082 spec, tube record)
coupons.pass: minimum wet slip load >= 1201 N at the upper-tee torque (1.2 x the larger of the pawl half-load 1000.5 N and the factored tee force 435 N); no tube dent > 0.1 mm

coupons.what: bolt bearing: 1 x .065 offcut, M5 + crush sleeve between two .090 gusset strips, pulled along the tube on the rig (come-along + crane scale), n 3
coupons.pass: hole elongation <= 0.2 mm at 1101 N (largest factored gusset-bolt force) and ultimate >= 1651 N
coupons.settles: bearing allowable at e/D 2, GAP-K joint stiffness

coupons.what: hip post proof: Ti mount on the two post angles, ties to two rung offcuts held in the gusset plates on the rig; load the pin with V 1630 N (+ H 1239 N) through a lever, hold 2 min
coupons.pass: no permanent set > 0.2 mm at the pin, no hole elongation, tie spacers undamaged; then 1e4 cycles 0 -> 870 N (walk V) with no crack (dye check)

coupons.what: fit-up: upper tee torqued on the stay top with the crown leg and bushing inside; pull the leg with a spring scale; then hang 1415 N aft on a 25 mm loop under the tee
coupons.pass: leg slide force <= 20 N at full torque and under the loop load; feeler gauge >= 0.3 mm radial at the bushing mouth
coupons.settles: ASSUMPTION FIT (bushing bore = leg + 1.0 mm), CLAMP-UNIFORM

coupons.what: notched tube fatigue (BL-082 rule: B fatigue margin 1.02 < 1.2): 1 x .065 offcuts with an M5 crush-sleeved through-bolt, 4-point bending on the T5 crank rig, R 0.1, n 3
coupons.pass: no crack (dye check) after 1e5 cycles at 1.2 x the walk bore stress of the worst stay hole (nominal 49 MPa x 1.2 at the hole fibre)
coupons.settles: Yahr mean curve, Kf = Kt, BJ-NOCREDIT

coupons.what: foot cup crush: printed cup + 38 x 38 foot plate + TPU pad in the vise / on the rig
coupons.pass: no crack at 4.0 kN (2 x C4 2001 N); record crush load (T4c estimate 17.9 kN ends in local crush)

coupons.what: static-cinch: 150 N x 1e4 cycles (T5 rig) on a webbing loop under a tee on a stay offcut
coupons.pass: no slip mark movement, re-torque angle < 10 deg (preload retention >= 0.9)

coupons.what: saddle plug: printed plug in a rung offcut pressed on a stay offcut sideways
coupons.pass: >= 1399 N without crack (1.5 x the largest factored plug force)
